The '''''Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and Theoretical''''' is a [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published by IOP Publishing, the publishing branch of the [[Institute of Physics]]. It is part of the ''[[Journal of Physics (disambiguation)|Journal of Physics]]'' series and covers [[theoretical physics]] focusing on sophisticated mathematical and computational techniques.

The journal is divided into six sections covering: [[statistical physics]]; [[chaos (physics)|chaotic]] and [[complex systems]]; [[mathematical physics]]; [[quantum mechanics]] and [[quantum information|quantum information theory]]; [[classical field theory|classical]] and [[quantum field theory]]; [[fluid mechanics|fluid]] and [[Plasma (physics)|plasma]] theory.

The [[editor in chief]] is Joseph A Minahan ([[Uppsala University|Uppsala Universitet]], Sweden). According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2025 [[impact factor]] of 1.9.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2026 |chapter=Journal of Physics A |title=2025 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate Analytics]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]]|title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref>

==History==
''Journal of Physics A'' was established in 1968 as one of the subdivisions of the earlier title, ''[[Proceedings of the Physical Society]]'', established in 1874, the flagship journal of the [[Physical Society of London]]. The Physical Society later became the Institute of Physics, the current publisher of the journal. Its papers began being made available electronically in 1991; by 2002, its entire back archive had been digitised, as the first step in a larger project to digitise all of the Institute's publishing archives.<ref>{{cite conference
 | last = O'Rourke | first = Tony
 | editor1-last = Corbin | editor1-first = Brenda G.
 | editor2-last = Bryson | editor2-first = Elizabeth P.
